subject: planner: Remove `CloneForPlanCache` method (#54528)
summary: Removes `Plan.CloneForPlanCache` and changes `PhysicalPlan.Clone` to accept a `PlanContext`, updating `SafeClone` and all affected callers (planner/executor). Instance plan cache cloning is switched to `PhysicalPlan.Clone(newCtx)`; PointGet/BatchPointGet no longer participate in clone-based cache tests because they don’t support `Clone` in this commit. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, concurrency, privilege, or session/transaction issues found in the touched planner/executor paths.
